inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL seed statement inserts rows from a derived UNION ALL relation and uses ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE with VALUES(...) to refresh columns, including JSON_ARRAY expressions produced by the derived source.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Rewritten as an independently authored notification-profile refresh. A derived UNION ALL source inserts one existing and one new profile, JSON_ARRAY builds channel lists, and a second insert conflicts through a secondary unique code to verify that the existing primary key remains while incoming values replace mutable fields. The source tables, rows, labels, and application purpose are new.

fixture_notes: Profile 1 is refreshed by a primary-key conflict and profile 2 is inserted from the same derived UNION ALL source. The second statement uses profile ID 3 with the existing standard code, so the secondary unique-key conflict refreshes profile 1 without creating ID 3. JSON_ARRAY channel lists and semantic JSON_LENGTH/JSON_UNQUOTE projections make both insert and update paths observable without depending on JSON column text formatting.
determinism_notes: All IDs, profile codes, labels, JSON values, priorities, source rows, and final ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE notification_profiles (profile_id INT PRIMARY KEY, profile_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL UNIQUE, channel_label VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, channels JSON NOT NULL, priority INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: INSERT INTO notification_profiles (profile_id, profile_code, channel_label, channels, priority) SELECT incoming.profile_id, incoming.profile_code, incoming.channel_label, incoming.channels, incoming.priority FROM (SELECT 1 AS profile_id, 'standard' AS profile_code, 'Standard delivery' AS channel_label, JSON_ARRAY('email', 'push') AS channels, 3 AS priority UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'critical', 'Critical delivery', JSON_ARRAY('sms', 'pager'), 5) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE channel_label = VALUES(channel_label), channels = VALUES(channels), priority = VALUES(priority)

INSERT INTO notification_profiles (profile_id, profile_code, channel_label, channels, priority) SELECT incoming.profile_id, incoming.profile_code, incoming.channel_label, incoming.channels, incoming.priority FROM (SELECT 3 AS profile_id, 'standard' AS profile_code, 'Standard override' AS channel_label, JSON_ARRAY('email', 'sms') AS channels, 4 AS priority) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE channel_label = VALUES(channel_label), channels = VALUES(channels), priority = VALUES(priority)

SELECT profile_id, profile_code, channel_label, JSON_LENGTH(channels) AS channel_count, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(channels, '$[0]')) AS first_channel, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(channels, '$[1]')) AS second_channel, priority FROM notification_profiles ORDER BY profile_id
